story.summary: Keeps the mission alive during the July 4, 2015 safing event, nine days before the Pluto flyby. The spacecraft went into safe mode after an over-assignment of commanded science operations and recovered within two days.
story.arc: Recovering the Pluto flyby in 2015: the DSN (command uplink and tracking), LORRI (optical navigation of Pluto against the stars) and the Time Knowledge Update (TKU), plus the software reload.
